notes:
## Bug fixes
- Locked contour sheets keep their sheet area when a project is reopened. Previously the locked area was not saved, so a reopened sheet could show and export a much smaller area. Sheets locked in earlier versions are restored from their saved view.
- The Inputs table appears immediately on large projects; about 1,800 objects now load in a fraction of a second instead of the table staying blank for up to two minutes.
- Opening a project shows its saved receptor results in the Results tab instead of "No receptor results yet".
